## Question and hypothesis

## Protocol

Data snapshot, query split, training budget, models, fixed settings, and comparison metric.

## Completion criteria

- [ ] Implement and test the change
- [ ] Evaluate on validation queries
- [ ] Record results and failure examples
- [ ] Update docs/PROGRESS.md and docs/ROADMAP.md

## Results and interpretation

Include negative outcomes and limitations. Do not tune on final test results.
